name: Thrown weapon appearances are enabled by the native login config (#4001)
contract: The client appearance population and validation paths require CONFIG_THROWN_WEAPON_APPEARANCES_ENABLED.
An absent flag hides weapon subclass 16 and rejects its selection. AscConfig replaces its scalar maps
from the single SMSG_UPDATE_CONFIGS packet, so the default CoA login must send that name followed by true.
Item 25861 is a level-one thrown weapon. ItemAppearances row 181248 maps item 29201 to appearance 12001
in category 12. The reported Tauren Barbarian must keep its equipped item when applying this appearance.
This exercises the native login and appearance protocols; it does not render the client wardrobe.

steps.label: Login sends one complete config packet
The login config enables thrown appearances
The same config preserves build inspection
The same config preserves XP rates
The appearance request receives one response
The appearance preserves the equipped weapon
